text_block_list.text:
Right before summer training camp, Twin 
Turbo mentions that she plans to run in 
the All Comers.

Ikuno Dictus, who was also slated to run 
in the All Comers, looked forward to the 
showdown.

And so the summer training camp arrived, 
but— Tokai Teio had yet to return from her 
injury, consumed by frustration and 
impatience.

With a whirlwind of mixed feelings, this 
year's summer training camp began.
